name: All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek
description:
Upon triggering Cryo-Related Reactions by any side: Randomly create 1 Gilded Hall, Autumn Frost, Wave-Kissed Sands, or Verdant Gift and add it to your Hand.
Usage(s): 2
